newsitem.title: USA: Hawk buys powder metal component maker Sinterloy.
newsitem.headline: Hawk buys powder metal component maker Sinterloy.

text.p: Hawk Corp said Monday it bought Sinterloy Inc of Solon Mills, Ill., for an undisclosed sum.
Hawk said the powder metal component manufacturer employs 86 and has annual revenues of about $15 million. Sinterloy's former owner and president Robert Sierks will remain president, Hawk said.
Company officials were not immediately available to elaborate on the deal.
Hawk is a manufacturer of friction materials, powder metal components and precision-engineered components. It employs 1,200 and has annual revenues of $160 million, including Sinterloy's.
